description: Send a bug report to FLUF's human support team. Use it when the user describes a problem with FLUF that can't be resolved here, or when a FLUF tool keeps failing or contradicts the user's account and the user agrees to report it. The report arrives as a direct message a person reads, so the fields are short: a title, two or three sentences, and the identifiers. Problems the user can fix themselves (expired token, lapsed plan, a channel needing reauthorisation) are not bugs — the fix belongs in the reply instead. The user's account identity is attached automatically. Replies arrive in the user's FLUF inbox.

context.description: Identifiers and raw error text only — FID/EID/VID, channel, listing id, the exact error string, a URL. One per line, no sentences. HARD LIMIT 500 characters.

description.description: What broke and what you expected instead. HARD LIMIT 500 characters — aim for two or three sentences. This is a support DM a person reads, not an incident report: no background, no restating the conversation, no rationale for why it matters, no summary of what you already tried.

severity.description: How blocking is this for the user. Default: medium.

title.description: One line naming the broken thing. No preamble, no severity word.

name: report_bug
